proposalReason: Across 32 research runs there were 18 drafted posts, 6 published posts, and 93 rejected candidates, indicating a substantial selection and drafting workload, but the aggregate has no rejection reasons or candidate-level feasibility outcomes to identify a cause. Site and social metrics are unavailable (site not connected; zero social posts measured), so no engagement effect can be inferred. Testing an explicit first-day action may make beginner feasibility assessments clearer; independent trials must determine whether it helps.
